items.title: Albert Warner Interview, 1959-01-08
items.q: You're Morris French. ... Morris French, he come after all those fellas. He was young. ... Yeah, he was all right. Yeah. Yeah, he's good.

ctx.x: That's right. Baptiste Delay. I think he was the first one to start playing drumming, I think. That's when I heard, I don't know. Baptiste Delay, yeah.
First one to start playing drumming? Slide drumming. Slide. Slide. Yeah, Slide. Yeah, Baptiste Delay. He used to play all his halls around here. You're Morris French.
